summary.priorityFormula: Priority = axis-weighted Impact x Innovation / log2(EffortHours + 2). Engagement and feedback evidence receive the strongest weight; privacy, UI, release, and efficiency remain binding.
summary.theme: Turn browser-first franchise receipts into a consented, privacy-bounded, near-live community intelligence surface without weakening local-first play or inventing adoption.

profile.source: founder-approved scope, current browser API seam, shared advance-week receipt authority, current PostgreSQL/Redis/Caddy compose, public privacy and metadata surfaces, and live Studio Canon 020/029/031/038/048/053/054

releaseGate.verdict: LOCAL IMPLEMENTATION GREEN — EXACT-CANDIDATE STAGING REQUIRED

Aggregate on the existing self-hosted PostgreSQL/Caddy plane with strict validation, deduplication, abuse ceilings, small-cell suppression and a cached public snapshot.

preverifiedSkips.candidate: Buy or add a third-party analytics platform
preverifiedSkips.reason: Rejected. The existing self-hosted PostgreSQL, Caddy and container deploy plane can own a bounded product aggregate at zero new vendor cost or data-sharing boundary.

preverifiedSkips.candidate: Describe the denominator as all players or all users
preverifiedSkips.reason: Rejected. Browser-first play has no identity census. The only defensible denominator is participating anonymous browsers within the displayed period.

preverifiedSkips.candidate: Upload complete saves to derive richer stats
preverifiedSkips.reason: Rejected. The shared API receipt seam exposes enough bounded facts; save payloads, names, free text, credentials and hidden simulation state remain local.
Rejected. Public ranks invite identity collection, gaming and false precision. Cohort distributions and suppressed rare-feat counts create useful comparison without exposing a person.

preverifiedSkips.candidate: Use a language model to narrate the snapshot
preverifiedSkips.reason: Rejected. Deterministic interpretation templates are cheaper, reproducible, auditable and cannot hallucinate a claim beyond the aggregate.

preverifiedSkips.candidate: Seed production with synthetic community activity
preverifiedSkips.reason: Rejected. Warming and honest-zero states are first-class UI states; synthetic events may exist only in tests and can never ship into the live aggregate.

items.title: No consented, cross-runtime authority exists for community evidence
items.premise: The browser and server runtimes already converge at createApiClient after API contract validation, and advance-week already emits a versioned receipt. No code converts those successful mutations into a bounded event, records explicit participation, keeps a local comparison ledger, or retries safely offline.
evidence: public/lib/api/createApiClient.js validates both runtime responses in one place
items.constraint: Collection is off until explicit opt-in. Transmit only allowlisted categorical dimensions and bounded numbers; never names, email, IP storage, free text, save payloads, player identifiers, credentials or hidden ratings.
verification: offline queue, batching and retry tests
both client and server runtime paths

L1.recipe: Record only local league starts and completed weeks behind an opt-in toggle.

L2.recipe: Create a versioned event catalog at the shared post-contract API seam; derive league, week, season, tactic, decision, roster-market, draft, staffing, challenge and rare-feat receipts; maintain a local-only comparison ledger; gate network batching behind explicit consent; support offline retry, bounded storage, withdrawal and deletion.

L3.recipe: L2 plus integrity-chain each browser receipt, surface an exact disclosure preview, and prove every event shape against both runtime adapters.

items.executionEvidence: Shipped a versioned allowlist and shared post-contract mutation seam with explicit opt-in, anonymous browser key, local-only ledger, bounded offline queue/batching, withdrawal and remote deletion. Tests prove redaction, clamps, derivation, local comparison, ingest and deletion.

items.title: There is no trustworthy live ingest, aggregation, or public snapshot plane
items.premise: The deploy stack already owns persistent PostgreSQL, Redis and Caddy, but product persistence is still file-backed and no community schema or endpoint exists. A separate bounded service can use the existing database and public API host without adding a vendor.
evidence: ops/deploy-backend.docker-compose.yml includes persistent PostgreSQL and Caddy
ops/Caddyfile already routes the public API origin
src/runtime/persistence.js confirms game saves do not currently use PostgreSQL
no community or telemetry service exists in src
items.constraint: Use an isolated schema and least-privilege-ready service boundary; validate and clamp every field; hash and delete participant keys; do not persist IPs; enforce idempotency, request/body ceilings, participant and IP rate limits, 30-day raw retention, k>=5 suppression, cache bounds and honest degraded states.
verification: dedupe, rate-limit, suppression and deletion tests
health, ETag/cache and stale fallback tests

L1.recipe: Add a validated ingest table and one cached headline snapshot.

L2.recipe: Ship an isolated self-hosted stats service with idempotent batched ingest, one-way participant hashing, delete-by-participant, retention cleanup, bounded rollups, percentile bands, deterministic insights, small-cell suppression, ETag caching, health/freshness states and deployment wiring on the existing API origin.

L3.recipe: L2 plus incremental materialized rollups, signed snapshot provenance, restore drill and sanitized Analytica consumption contract.

items.executionEvidence: Shipped an isolated PostgreSQL community_stats schema/service with migration ledger, one-way participant hashing, request/rate/retention ceilings, dedupe, k=5 suppression, 24h/7d/30d aggregates, deterministic insights, ETag caching and honest fallback; wired Compose, Caddy and backend workflow. Contract/server tests 7/7; Compose config passes.

items.title: The homepage has no living proof of what the community is building
items.premise: The homepage moves directly from the hero into Quick Start. There is no community surface, no participation control, and no safe warming/stale state despite CANON-054 now requiring a public stats surface.
evidence: public/index.html places New Franchise immediately after the hero
public/setup.js has no community fetch or consent behavior
public/styles.css already owns responsive theme tokens that can carry a dependency-free pulse
items.constraint: Keep the instant-start funnel primary. Use no chart dependency, no auto-scrolling distraction, no fabricated zero, and no claim beyond the displayed period and participating-browser denominator. Poll only while visible and respect reduced motion/data preferences.
verification: loading, warming, live, stale and unavailable states

L1.recipe: Add four cached count cards below the hero.

L2.recipe: Build a cinematic Community Pulse below the hero with honest participation context, four headline measures, one deterministic live insight, freshness badge, participation controls and a progressive link to the full atlas; refresh only while visible and preserve the one-click start hierarchy.

L3.recipe: L2 plus a lightweight accessible strategy constellation and live-change micro-transitions that respect reduced motion and data preferences.

items.executionEvidence: Shipped a compact Community Pulse immediately below the hero with four live measures, denominator/methodology truth, deterministic insight, freshness state, consent controls and a visibility/save-data-aware 30-second refresh. Desktop/mobile dark/light captures inspected with no blocking defects; boot budget remains green.

items.category: Stats Atlas / dual audience / feedback loop
items.title: A headline pulse alone cannot expose the valuable breadth, methodology, or local comparison
items.premise: The product can derive activity, league setup, strategy, tactics, outcomes, roster-market behavior, draft philosophy, pressure, challenges and rare feats, but has no public /stats information architecture or machine-readable twin.
evidence: CANON-054 requires value, period, computedAt and interpretation
items.constraint: Every displayed statistic declares value, unit, period, sample size, computedAt and interpretation. Suppressed, warming, stale, unavailable and unmeasured states remain explicit. Local comparison never uploads additional state.
verification: agents.json, llms.txt, sitemap, privacy, terms and manifest truth

L1.recipe: Add a static /stats page that renders the headline snapshot and methodology.

L2.recipe: Ship a responsive Stats Atlas covering scale, league lab, team loyalty, strategy, tactics, roster market, draft room, pressure/outcomes, challenges and rare feats; add local-only percentile comparisons, filterable periods, deterministic interpretations, a documented JSON twin, methodology/privacy disclosure and complete sitemap/agent/LLM navigation.

L3.recipe: L2 plus accessible historical sparklines, shareable stat cards and signed snapshot provenance without adding a charting dependency.

items.executionEvidence: Shipped /stats.html with nine valuable category groups, period filters, local-only percentile comparison, warming/suppressed/stale/unavailable states, methodology and JSON twin navigation. Agents, llms, sitemap, privacy, terms, footer and manifest truth updated; CANON-054 passes 6/6.

items.title: A live data surface needs exact-revision operational and rendered-pixel proof
items.premise: The current release train proves static Pages and game routes but knows nothing about stats service health, snapshot freshness, privacy controls, suppressed states or the two new public surfaces.
evidence: existing Pages and backend workflows are separate
CANON-053 requires desktop/mobile/theme pixel receipts for touched UI
items.constraint: Do not release on source or unit tests alone. Exact candidate staging must prove the page, API freshness and CORS; production must be SHA/fingerprint-bound. Existing launch email/approval/lifecycle gates remain independent and cannot be inferred closed.
verification: stats service contract and migration dry run

L1.recipe: Add build/smoke coverage and inspect one desktop/mobile theme pair.

L2.recipe: Extend build, smoke, edge, Playwright and visual evidence gates across every stats state and theme; deploy the exact candidate to staging and the self-hosted service; verify CORS, cache, freshness and rollback; then release and reconcile truth without changing independent launch gates.

L3.recipe: L2 plus automated freshness SLO monitoring, restore drill evidence and a post-release live-change canary receipt.

items.executionEvidence: Local proof is green, including full runtime/core/simulation/UI gates and eight hash-bound rendered captures. Exact-candidate commit, staging/API deployment, live CORS/cache/freshness checks, production verification and rollback receipt remain.
